summary: QuickEntryFindStudent is a web page and server-side workflow within the HSPnet application that enables users to search for students to place in a program. It provides filtering by last name, first name, student number, and consent program. It includes grid-based selection, error/warning panels, and JavaScript-driven UI interactions for selection, validation, and result binding.
purpose: To facilitate rapid identification and selection of students for placement in programs, with options to filter, select, and add students based on consent and core identifiers.

fields.name: txtStudentIDs
fields.purpose: Comma-separated list of selected student IDs

workflows.name: Find and Select Students
steps: User lands on QuickEntryFindStudent page, page loads consent programs and sets defaults from query string.
User enters search criteria (last name, first name, student number, consent program).
User clicks 'Search', triggering validation (at least one search field required).
System executes data source selection with provided filters.
Result grid (uxMaster) is populated with matching students.
User may select all/none or select individual students (via checkboxes).
User clicks 'Add Selected Students', which copies selected IDs and names to parent window using JavaScript.
User may clear search, close window, or see warnings/errors as appropriate.

business_rules: At least one of last name, first name, or student number must be entered for search.
Program filter defaults to the passed-in ProgramID.
Warning is displayed if program filter does not match the ProgramID from the query string.
validations: ClientValidationFunction=ValidateSearch ensures at least one of last, first, or student number is not empty.
Consent program validation via dropdown; auto-postback triggers search.
calculations: Student count is incremented based on selected students added.
ID and Name lists in parent window are updated via JavaScript.
conditions: If no students match, selection panel (spnSelect) is hidden.
If program dropdown does not match passed ProgramID, warning panel is shown.
system_behavior: On page load, sets up consent program dropdown, default values, and JavaScript includes.
Handles postback and async postback scenarios differently for script registration.
Binds grid based on search criteria.
Builds client-side checkbox list for selection logic.
Displays errors and warnings as needed, with user interaction to hide panels.
dependencies: Dropdown utility for consent program selection
exceptions: If checkboxes or hidden fields are missing when adding students, script returns false.
If script registration in async postback fails, fallback to client script registration.
